description: React component for editing notes, including state management, saving, loading, and deletion functionalities.

methods.name: NoteEditor
methods.description: Main React component for editing a note, managing state, and handling save/delete actions.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the note data if not provided initially when component mounts.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Returns a handler to update note fields for title and content.

methods.name: maybeBlurSave
methods.description: Debounced save triggered on input blur if the note is dirty.

methods.name: doSave
methods.description: Performs save with optimistic update, handles debounce, and shows confirmation.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes the current note and redirects to notes list.
